HONORARY DIRECTOR

Dr. Divya C. Senan

Honorary Director, LEnSE

Dr. Divya C. Senan serves as Associate Professor in the Department of Education and Honorary Director of the Centre for Learning Engineering & Sustainability Education (CLESE) at the University of Kerala. She also served as a Visiting Professor at the University of Southampton, UK. With a Ph.D. in Education and postdoctoral research experiences in Educational Policy Planning and Environmental Education from the NSSTC, University of Alabama in Huntsville, USA, she brings over 18 years of academic and research expertise.
